name: Wikelo Emporium
description: After many successful cycles at the head of a fabrication souli, Wikelo found themselves lacking in the drive that had defined their early career. In a shock to many, the Banu decided to divest from their souli early and follow their true passion - collecting and fabricating unique items and vehicles. Drawn to manufacturing-style of Humans, it wasn't long before Wikelo had established a remote trading shop inside Human-space, Wikelo Emporium, where they could grow their collection and barter with those who shared their passions.
